channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Timofey Mozgov | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Timofey Mozgov from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sean Marks on Timofey Mozgov
item.description:
#Nets GMSean Marks on Timofey Mozgov's comments:

“That’s completely Timo’s comments & thoughts... I’ve had good conversations with Timo since then. I wish Timo nothing but the best in life in general. He’s a terrific, terrific guy. That’s all I got to say about that.”

Sean Marks on Timofey Mozgov, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Big Sean on Timofey Mozgov, D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“We are extremely excited to welcome D’Angelo and Timofey to our Brooklyn Nets family,”

Big Sean on Timofey Mozgov, D'Angelo Russell, Jun 22, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Timofey Mozgov
item.description:
“Timofey is a player who has shown the ability to change the game at the defensive end, and fills an area of need for us at the center position,”

Mitch Kupchak on Timofey Mozgov, Jul 8, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Love on Timofey Mozgov
item.description:
“I think a guy was closing out on me and I hit Delly and Delly didn't end up shooting it. But, no, I think I had some good looks in the first quarter -- a couple tip-ins that I missed; [Timofey Mozgov] and I both went for the lob, I thought I had my hand on it, and missed that one. But, you know, getting good looks there. Not for lack of confidence, no.”

Kevin Love on Timofey Mozgov, Feb 3, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: David Griffin on Timofey Mozgov
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:David Griffin on Mozgov:

“This puts us in position to battle any size we may face. I wish I could put him out there for the 2nd half.”

David Griffin on Timofey Mozgov, Jan 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Sergey Monya on Timofey Mozgov
item.description:
Sergey Monya:

“Of all the players missing in this tournament, Timofey Mozgov was the only guy I didn't know the reason for not playing. That's my opinion, I'm not going to discuss it, but in the end I don't understand why he wasn't here. If I'm honest, he didn't play all season and now he would've played 40 minutes a game until he fouled out, he would have averaged 20 and 10 and would have brought some value to the team.”

Sergey Monya on Timofey Mozgov, Sep 10, 2013. Source: rsport.ru.
